game_name: Super Street Fighter II X: Grand Master Challenge (Japan 940223 Phoenix Edition) (bootleg)
general_issues: Select ssf2xjr1d.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
